techdella.help: Tiles: {type, span (1-12), spanTablet (1-6), rows (1-3), variant (paper|canvas|sand|dark|photo), url, eyebrow, title, text, …}. Types: stat {value, label, note, avatars[], avatarsMore}; image {image, alt, title, text}; photo {image, alt, eyebrow, title, url}; quote {quote, name, role, image} (verbatim §2.4 quotes only); link {image, alt, chip, title, linkLabel, url}; platform-list {platforms[{name,mark}], thumb, thumbCaption}; search {links[], serp{}, answer{}, caption}; form {formTitle, formButton}; sequence {rows[{label,status,strong,dot}], caption}; flow {steps[{label,highlight}]}. URLs: '/path/' (this site) or 'studios:/path/', 'journal:/path/', 'marketing:/path/'. Stats: verified proof only.
